recordDecisions.title: A New Bound for the Gauss Circle Problem
recordDecisions.boundedClaim: For X>=4 the lattice-point discrepancy E(X)=#{(a,b) in Z²:a²+b²<=X}−πX is O_epsilon(X^(209/670+epsilon)), breaking the 5/16 threshold; this is not the conjectured exponent1/4.

recordDecisions.furtherChecking: Identify the decisive AI mathematical step and model allocation; independently check cone-distribution estimates, Taylor constraints and the claimed uniform range. No independent proof verification is claimed. No downloaded proof artifact was executed. Retain provisional=1, low strict confidence, taxonomy unreviewed and no strict Superhuman override.

recordDecisions.title: Optimally large cuts in both directions
recordDecisions.boundedClaim: For each fixed integer d>=2 and sufficiently large m, every m-edge digraph of minimum outdegree at least d has a vertex bipartition with at least ceil((d−1)m/(2(2d−1))+d²/(2(2d−1))) edges in each direction; the bound is attained for infinitely many m. The d=2 bound ceil(m/6) holds for all m.

recordDecisions.furtherChecking: Check sufficiently-large-m dependencies, exact rounding and extremal examples, and obtain the Lean certificate reported as available on request. This does not claim an arbitrary-d uniform finite-m theorem. No downloaded proof artifact was executed. Retain provisional=1, low strict confidence, taxonomy unreviewed and no strict Superhuman override.
